datasheet_identity.title: US1A THRU US1M SURFACE MOUNT HIGH EFFICIENT RECTIFIER

extraction_notes: Page 1 identifies US1K as the 800 V variant: VRRM = 800 V and VDC = 800 V; IF(AV) = 1.0 A and IFSM = 30 A. The datasheet states that the cathode line denotes the cathode end.

Page 2 Fig. 3 was digitized from the dotted US1J-US1M typical forward-voltage curve, which includes US1K. The current axis is logarithmic and the curve is specified for Tj = 25 degC, 300 us pulse width, and 1% duty cycle.

Page 2 Fig. 4 was digitized for both Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 125 degC. Its x-axis is percent of rated peak reverse voltage, so the curve x-values are retained as percentages rather than converted to absolute reverse voltage.

The table gives US1K maximum VF = 1.7 V at IF = 1.0 A, maximum Trr = 75 ns, maximum IR1 = 5.0 uA at rated DC blocking voltage and TA = 25 degC, maximum IR2 = 500 uA at TA = 100 degC, and typical CJ = 20 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz.

Breakdown voltage and breakdown current are omitted because the datasheet supplies reverse-voltage ratings and leakage characteristics, not a breakdown test point; VRRM and VDC were not treated as breakdown evidence.
